reason: The conclusion stands: no action before R8, and I-222 stays on the post-deadline list. The quantitative bound the finding wants written into the ledger is wrong, about 2.3x too loose. The +0.011 comes from 0.342 x 0.0754 x 0.35 (44b6) + 0.04 x 0.0754 x 0.65 (6bba), which assumes primary-only frames hold a share of GT edges proportional to their frame count. The measured flicker counts (round3/scan_hypotheses.notes.md l.18-24) say otherwise. Primary-only frames hold only 1,960 (prim-prim) + 529 (all-prim clips) + 876 (switch pairs) = 3,365 of 40,093 GT edges (8.4%). Assume a fully causal drop to the blended FN rate (3.17%; 4.16%/6.05% baselines for the other groups). That gives 148 + 17 + 25 = ~190 recovered edges = 0.0047 of pooled GT edges. The metric is per-video J weighted by GT edges, and dJ <= dFN/GT with FP fixed, so the pooled causal upper bound is ~+0.005, not +0.011. The real value is likely <= 0, for four reasons. (1) The FN gap is a selection effect: fallback fires on hard frames (R3S-5). (2) In exactly those frames the blend keeps 15-22% fewer candidates (round9 recheck). (3) Forcing the blend changes the node set (R4) and needs a GPU lab because the det logits are not cached. (4) It is a public-tuned knob that cannot get a lab gate, a dummy and a user OK by 27 Sep 12:00 UTC (R8). Both finals, #37 and #38, carry the same guard, so the finals choice is unaffected. It is not a closed line in disguise: it only restates I-222/R3S-5.
fix: Keep 'no action before R8; post-deadline shake-up analysis only'. Correct the ledger note for I-222: 'Causal upper bound (lab, pooled, edge-weighted) ~ +0.005. Primary-only frames hold 3,365/40,093 GT edges (8.4%). Removing the whole FN gap vs blended frames recovers ~190 edges. This is an upper bound: selection effect, and the blend drops 15-22% of candidates in those frames, so the likely sign is <= 0.' Do not record +0.011, and do not use frame share (33.1%) as an edge share.
realistic_gain: 0 before the deadline (documentation only; both finals share the guard). Post-deadline counterfactual ceiling ~ +0.005 pooled in the lab, likely <= 0 in practice.
